project_comments.note: Architectural observation (cross-cutting): project-reset.ts (line 430) defines a local nonTerminalStatuses = ['READY', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED'] array inline instead of using the shared isTerminalStatus() helper from validators.ts. The two definitions are functionally equivalent today (enum has exactly 5 values), but the inline approach will silently diverge if a new value is ever added to WorkPackageStatus. The correct pattern — !isTerminalStatus(wp.status) — is already used in work-package.ts line 1111 and project-lifecycle.ts. Recommend a follow-up refactor in project-reset.ts to import isTerminalStatus and use it consistently. Low priority but worth capturing as a future-context debt item.
